cases.label: The first page of orders
cases.sql:
SELECT order_id, placed_at, status
FROM orders
ORDER BY placed_at DESC, order_id DESC
LIMIT 2;

cases.label: The second numbered page
cases.sql:
SELECT order_id, placed_at, status
FROM orders
ORDER BY placed_at DESC, order_id DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 2;

cases.label: Continue after time and order ID
cases.sql:
SELECT order_id, placed_at, status
FROM orders
WHERE placed_at < timestamptz '2026-10-20 10:15:00+00'
   OR (placed_at = timestamptz '2026-10-20 10:15:00+00'
       AND order_id < 201)
ORDER BY placed_at DESC, order_id DESC
LIMIT 2;

cases.label: The same continuation as a row comparison
cases.sql:
SELECT order_id, placed_at, status
FROM orders
WHERE (placed_at, order_id)
    < (timestamptz '2026-10-20 10:15:00+00', 201)
ORDER BY placed_at DESC, order_id DESC
LIMIT 2;

cases.label: A continuation for mixed sort directions
cases.sql:
SELECT order_id, placed_at, status
FROM orders
WHERE placed_at < timestamptz '2026-10-20 10:15:00+00'
   OR (placed_at = timestamptz '2026-10-20 10:15:00+00'
       AND order_id > 201)
ORDER BY placed_at DESC, order_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

cases.label: Continue from a measured weight into the null group
cases.sql:
SELECT product_id, package_weight_g
FROM products
WHERE package_weight_g > 820
   OR (package_weight_g = 820 AND product_id > 'P9')
   OR package_weight_g IS NULL
ORDER BY package_weight_g ASC NULLS LAST, product_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

cases.label: Find the nearest two rows before page two
cases.sql:
SELECT order_id, placed_at, status
FROM orders
WHERE (placed_at, order_id)
    > (timestamptz '2026-10-20 10:15:00+00', 103)
ORDER BY placed_at ASC, order_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

cases.label: Wrong: timestamp alone loses 103
Wrong: inclusive pair repeats 201
Request one extra row, display only 202 and 201
cases.sql:
SELECT order_id, placed_at, status
FROM orders
ORDER BY placed_at DESC, order_id DESC
LIMIT 3;
